basic_details.job_title: INMS Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Nano Medical Sciences (INMS), Faculty of Medical Sciences, University of Delhi, needs a Research Associate - I for its project "Advanced R&D in Nanomedicine for Affordable Cancer Diagnostics and comprehensive Open – Source Knowledge Dissemination". The post is temporary, non-regular and co-terminus with the project, and it carries a fixed monthly emolument. Candidates need a Ph.D. in Chemistry/ Nanomedical Sciences/ Life Sciences and at least one high-impact nanomedicine publication. To apply, candidates email their updated CV by 16 November 2026 and then attend the walk-in in

age_limit.details: The age limit is a maximum of 35 years, counted as on the day of interview.

qualification.details: Candidates must have a Ph.D. degree in Chemistry/ Nanomedical Sciences/ Life Sciences with a Master's degree (M.S./ M.Sc./ M.Pharm or equivalent) in a relevant subject with at least 1st Division or 55% marks (or equivalent CGPA).

how_to_apply: Applications go by email only, by 16 November 2026. The notice gives these steps:
Prepare an updated CV and the relevant document(s).
Email the CV with the documents to both addresses: [email protected] and [email protected].
Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM at the venue, with original certificates, an updated CV and one set of photocopies of the certificates.

All correspondence from INMS, University of Delhi, if any, will be sent only to the email address the applicant provides. For a persistent technical issue, applicants can write to [email protected] and [email protected].
Relevant document(s) sent with the email
Original certificates, to bring to the interview
One set of photocopies of the certificates, to bring to the interview
important_instructions: Applications that do not meet the eligibility criteria or are incomplete in any respect shall be summarily rejected. Applicants must not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars or suppress any information; the applicant is solely responsible for the authenticity of the submitted information. INMS will verify the antecedents of the applicant at the time of appointment or anytime during the tenure; if false information is found, the services shall be terminated. A candidature based on incorrect, forged or falsified credentials is liable to be cancelled at any stage, with legal action under applicable law. INMS reserves the right to modify/withdraw/cancel any communication made to applicants, including after an offer letter in case of an inadvertent mistake; the decision of the University shall be final. Canvassing in any form will be treated as a disqualification. Any dispute regarding the recruitment will fall under the jurisdiction of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must have a Ph.D. degree in Chemistry/ Nanomedical Sciences/ Life Sciences with a Master's degree (M.S./ M.Sc./ M.Pharm or equivalent) in a relevant subject with at least 1st Division or 55% marks (or equivalent CGPA). Candidates must have at least 01 relevant high-impact publication (in Q1 or Q2 journals) in the area of nanomedicine in Scopus indexed journals/UGC-CARE listed journals as a first author or corresponding author. The age limit is a maximum of 35 years, counted as on the day of interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for the Research Associate - I post is a fixed monthly emolument. The notice does not print the amount. The tenure is temporary, non-regular and strictly co-terminus with the specific research project. Meeting the qualification or eligibility criteria alone does not entitle an applicant to selection.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the INMS Research Associate - I post is by a walk-in interview held in hybrid mode on 17 November 2026. Candidates report at 10:00 AM for the offline interview at Room No. 105, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Center for Biomedical Research (ACBR), University of Delhi (North Campus), Delhi-110007. In special circumstances, with the permission of the Director, candidates may be allowed to appear for the interview online through the link https://meet.google.com/nmd-nzbt-xhr . No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the INMS Research Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must email their updated CV by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. When is the INMS Research Associate - I walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM at Room No. 105, ACBR, University of Delhi (North Campus), Delhi-110007.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for INMS Research Associate - I?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. degree in Chemistry/ Nanomedical Sciences/ Life Sciences with a Master's degree (M.S./ M.Sc./ M.Pharm or equivalent) in a relevant subject with at least 1st Division or 55% marks (or equivalent CGPA), plus at least 01 high-impact Q1 or Q2 publication in nanomedicine as first or corresponding author.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for INMS Research Associate - I?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years as on the day of interview.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation for INMS Research Associate - I?
faq.answer: SC, ST, Physically Handicapped and Women applicants get a relaxation of up to 5 years, and OBC applicants get 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for INMS Research Associate - I?
faq.answer: Email your updated CV with the relevant document(s) to [email protected] and [email protected] by 16 November 2026, then attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of INMS Research Associate - I?
faq.answer: The post carries a fixed monthly emolument.

faq.question: Q8. Can I attend the INMS interview online?
faq.answer: Only in special circumstances, with the permission of the Director, a candidate may be allowed to join online through https://meet.google.com/nmd-nzbt-xhr; the interview is otherwise offline.

faq.question: Q9. Is the INMS Research Associate - I post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The tenure is temporary, non-regular and strictly co-terminus with the specific research project.

faq.question: Q10. Will INMS pay travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid.
